tasks.description:

**Files:** sdk/package.json (modify: add workspaces field), parity/package.json, parity/tsconfig.json, parity/vitest.config.ts, parity/eslint.config.js, parity/.gitignore, parity/src/index.ts.

**Verify:** `npm install && cd parity && npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files":["package.json","parity/package.json","parity/tsconfig.json","parity/vitest.config.ts","parity/eslint.config.js","parity/.gitignore","parity/src/index.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd parity && npx tsc --noEmit","acceptanceCriteria":["sdk/package.json has workspaces:[parity]","@livefolio/parity is private:true with deps on @livefolio/sdk (workspace) and @livefolio/datafeed-yfinance (file:../../yfinance)","npm install succeeds with symlinks to both deps","tsc --noEmit succeeds"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Vendor yfinance fixtures into parity/fixtures/
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Copy SPY/QQQ/IEF 2020-2024 yfinance fixture JSONs into parity/fixtures/ so the workspace is self-contained for CI.

**Files:** parity/fixtures/{SPY,QQQ,IEF}-2020-2024.json, parity/fixtures/README.md.

**Verify:** `cmp parity/fixtures/SPY-2020-2024.json ../yfinance/test/fixtures/SPY-2020-2024.json` (and QQQ, IEF) → exit 0.

```json:metadata
{"files":["parity/fixtures/SPY-2020-2024.json","parity/fixtures/QQQ-2020-2024.json","parity/fixtures/IEF-2020-2024.json","parity/fixtures/README.md"],"verifyCommand":"cmp parity/fixtures/SPY-2020-2024.json ../yfinance/test/fixtures/SPY-2020-2024.json","acceptanceCriteria":["All 3 JSONs byte-identical to yfinance source","README documents source path and refresh procedure","Fixtures are git-tracked"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Canonical parity strategy + matching TacticalSpec
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Author SPY/QQQ/IEF weekly trend strategy as both v0.3 fluent code and TacticalSpec in one file. Ships PARITY_SPEC, buildV3Strategy, PARITY_RANGE/_V3.

**Strategy:** weekly rebalance, 2 rules. Rule 1: Price(SPY) > SMA(SPY,200) → 60%SPY/40%QQQ. Rule 2 (fallback): 100%IEF.

**Files:** parity/src/strategy.ts, parity/src/strategy.test.ts.

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/strategy.test.ts` → green.

```json:metadata
{"files":["parity/src/strategy.ts","parity/src/strategy.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd parity && npx vitest run src/strategy.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["buildV3Strategy(client) returns StrategyHandle","PARITY_SPEC has kind tactical/v0 (becomes v1 in Task 9), 3 universe entries, 2 features, if/else rule","≥3 tickers, ≥1 signal-driven branch — meets spec parity-case requirements","Round-trip test: feature refs declared, weights in universe"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Allocation diff harness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** compareAllocationHistories(a, b, opts?) → DiffReport. Pure outer-join on (date, assetId), tolerance, ignoreDates/ignoreAssets.

**Files:** parity/src/diff.ts, parity/src/diff.test.ts.

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/diff.test.ts` → green.

```json:metadata
{"files":["parity/src/diff.ts","parity/src/diff.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd parity && npx vitest run src/diff.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["DiffReport: {matched, diffs, onlyInA, onlyInB}","Cell mismatch when |b−a| > weightTolerance (default 1e-9)","ignoreDates/ignoreAssets honored","diffs sorted by (date, assetId); dates lists sorted","Never throws"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Parity test (the gate)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire v0.3 (FixtureMarketProvider + InMemoryStorageProvider + buildV3Strategy + simulate) and v0.4 (YfinanceDataFeed + fromSpec(PARITY_SPEC) + runBacktest) over SPY/QQQ/IEF 2020-06→2024-12, extract both histories, diff, assert empty.

Likely fails on first run — that's expected. Capture diff output as input for Task 8.

**Files:** parity/src/parity.test.ts.

**Verify:** `cd parity && npx vitest run src/parity.test.ts` → green is the gate.

```json:metadata
{"files":["parity/src/parity.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd parity && npx vitest run src/parity.test.ts","acceptanceCriteria":["Loads SPY/QQQ/IEF fixtures once, shares across both sides","v0.3 simulate runs without network (storage + market are fixture-backed)","v0.4 runBacktest runs against YfinanceDataFeed wrapping the same fixtures","Logs first 10 diffs + onlyIn lists + matched count on failure (informative)","Asserts diffs empty, onlyIn lists empty, matched > 0"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8 (CONDITIONAL): Document divergences and fix bugs
tasks.description:
**Skip if Task 7 passes outright.** Otherwise: classify each diff entry as (a) real bug → fix in source, (b) structural difference → document in docs/specs/2026-05-02-v0.4-parity-divergences.md and codify allowance in parity test, (c) wiring mistake → fix.

Do NOT widen tolerance to make the test pass without root-cause analysis.

**Files:** docs/specs/2026-05-02-v0.4-parity-divergences.md (NEW, conditional), parity/src/divergences.ts (NEW, conditional), parity/src/parity.test.ts (modify to import allowances), plus any source fixes.

**Verify:** `cd parity && npm test && cd .. && npm test && cd ../yfinance && npm test` → all green, no regressions.

```json:metadata
{"files":["docs/specs/2026-05-02-v0.4-parity-divergences.md","parity/src/divergences.ts","parity/src/parity.test.ts"],"verifyCommand":"cd parity && npm test","acceptanceCriteria":["Each diff entry classified: bug-fixed | structural-allowance | wiring-fixed","Divergence spec has reproduction, root-cause, justification, future-work for each allowance","DiffOptions in parity.test.ts correspond 1:1 to spec entries (not hand-tuned)","sdk + parity + yfinance suites all green"]}
```

**Verify:** `npm test && cd parity && npm test && cd ../yfinance && npm test` → all green.
